lines: if you've never really been loved, you get attached way too easily.
someone texts you good morning once, and you already picture a whole future with them.
you read every message three times, looking for something they didn't mean.
you notice when their replies get shorter. you notice everything.
and when they go quiet, you don't think they're busy.
you think you finally showed them too much of who you are.
so you make yourself smaller. easier. quieter.
you say it's fine so many times, you start believing your feelings are the problem.
you give people the love you were always waiting for, hoping one day it comes back.
and when they leave, it doesn't feel like losing them.
it feels like proof. like you were right about yourself all along.
you're not too much. you were just never held the way you needed.
and the way you love, so deeply, so carefully, that was never the weakness.
one day someone will stay. not because you begged. just because they want to.
